items.text: Electrical power systems careers cover generation, transmission, distribution, protection, metering and renewable integration, and they suit engineers who like large systems, safety rules and steady shift work, with recruitment often through exams and notices.
Recruitment exams, eligibility, safety rules and licensing requirements are set by employers and regulators and change.
